name: Blythe?
source:
Born to liberate, Blythe wants nothing more than to give Bunnie their best-ever birthday. Suave, domineering, and mysterious, as well as flirty and overly confident, Blythe's only reason for existence is to bring a little happiness into Bunnie's life... at any cost!

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/bittersweetblythe]Itch.io[/url]]
